scope: Original descriptive metadata only. Original binary backups remain ignored; simulation payloads unchanged in normalized published packets.

rows.originalMethod: Outcome-selected unchanged native Game prefix from original league rosters/game seed, then natural complete target PlaySim. Only target full-recorded before its constructor. Wrap actual behavior/see/World calls once without new observations, decisions, RNG or prescribed movement. Complete enumerable projections, whole-tick hashes, natural result and copied next RNG match plain and original light game; settled target log and earlier prefix match original.
originalLimits: Selected retrospective mechanism witnesses, not frequency or calibration estimates.
Prehistory is reproduced natively; module WeakMaps are not serialized or independently hashed.
Stops after selected snap naturally finishes and normal Game bookkeeping; no full-game-after-target parity claim.
Full telemetry and raw diagnostic support/world fields are diagnostic, not information supplied to controllers.
